page.overview:
Who is Chain Chomp?

Chain Chomp is a character in Mario Party Advance. He is a representative of his own species, Chain Chomp, and has an identical appearance to them. Chain Chomp's quest is titled Chomper Stomper. In it, Mario has to defeat Chain Chomp in the Duel minigame Chain Saw. In the ending, it is stated that Chain Chomp took Whomp's place as the new guardian of Duel Tower's first floor.
